scientific_integrity: The all-order two-class generating formula is proved by a finite 256-state transfer identity and a fully reproduced exact-integer 256-step determinant calculation. All 729 ternary recurrence initial values are exhaustively checked after proving period 30. Numerical tests alone are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only GP(n,2) for integer n>=5. The rational generating function has an explicit degree-64 denominator. A conceptual eigenvalue derivation is not supplied. Independent mathematical or historical audit has not been performed and priority remains subject to further literature examination.
title: Complete total-domatic partition counts for \(\operatorname{GP}(n,2)\)
